programme.desc: Dalam keadaan ribut kuat melanda, kura-kura ninja bersama Splinter dan sekutu mutan mereka terperangkap di markas bawah tanah. Namun, Splinter tetap mengarahkan mereka keluar menjalankan misi, dengan setiap kura-kura dipasangkan bersama rakan mutan. Raphael bergerak bersama Scumbug dan Ray Fillet untuk menyiasat bunyi jentera berhampiran. programme.title: Matt & Mou
programme.desc: Kisah persahabatan rapat antara Matthew dan Mouretta yang telah berkawan sejak kecil walaupun mempunyai personaliti yang sangat berbeza. Matt seorang yang sangat melindungi dan sentiasa mengambil berat tentang Mou, termasuk dalam soal percintaan. Apabila Mou mula jatuh cinta kepada Reza, seorang pemuzik yang kelihatan sempurna, Matt berasa curiga dan tidak merestui hubungan mereka. Demi mendapatkan persetujuan Matt, Mou cuba menjodohkan Matt dengan Retha, sepupu Reza, namun keadaan menjadi semakin rumit apabila timbul perasaan cemburu dan konflik dalam persahabatan mereka. Kehilangan Reza secara tiba-tiba pula menimbulkan pelbagai persoalan dan rahsia yang akhirnya menguji hubungan Matt dan Mou, sambil menyedarkan mereka tentang perasaan sebenar yang terpendam selama ini. Lakonan : Maxime Bouttier, Prilly Latuconsina, Kelsea Dressler, Marthino Lio dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Enjoy Your Stay
programme.desc: Kehilangan Tuan Rudi sudah menjadi buah mulut pekerja Damai Beach Resort. Tiba-tiba pekerja am Sean dan Beber diangkat menjadi pengurus segera kerana mereka yang paling lama berkhidmat di Damai Beach Resort selain Kak Maggie yang sudah amnesia. Sean dan Beber mempunyai dua sikap yang berbeza namun mereka perlu bersama-sama menjadi pengurus hotel untuk menyelamatkan hotel tersebut sementara menunggu kepulangan Tuan Rudi dan mendapatkan gaji mereka yang tertunggak. Kak Maggie seorang wanita cina yang buat kerja seperti sloth tetapi tahu tentang semua kedudukan kewangan hotel. Tuan Rudi pula telah melarikan diri kerana dia dikejar oleh Ah Long kerana tidak mampu membayar hutang.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。

programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: National Anthem
programme.desc: The broadcast of Malaysia’s national anthem, Negaraku, marks the beginning of the daytime broadcast schedule.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation of human-interest stories from around the world. This episode features a Women-run hotel in Sri Lanka that empowers women through the tourism industry. It also highlights Traditional wooden toy-making in Channapatna, India, where local artisans strive to preserve their craft amid modernisation and competition from imported products. Efforts to save the northern white rhino at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya continue through in vitro fertilisation (IVF) technology to prevent the subspecies from becoming extinct. Meanwhile, Benin’s textile industry is expanding its local manufacturing capabilities, shifting from raw cotton exports to textile production to create jobs and boost the country’s economy. The episode also explores the importance of international engagement and dialogue in helping countries such as Malaysia compete in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Global Perspective
programme.desc: This episode of Global Perspective discusses the evolution of Malaysia’s foreign policy since Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took office in November 2022, focusing on strengthening ties with Islamic countries in areas including the Palestinian issue, economic cooperation, education and moderation. The programme also highlights Malaysia’s strategic relations with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Central Asia, as well as the potential for international media collaboration to strengthen diplomacy and deliver accurate information to global audiences.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us explores diverse cultural traditions, artistic expressions and heritage from around the world, including ice carving in Japan, a unique peanut butter art installation in Rotterdam, Arabian horse traditions in Palestine and camel racing in Australia. This episode also highlights the traditional fishing practices of the Imragan community in Mauritania, France’s return of historical Syrian artefacts, and Malaysia’s strategic role in strengthening international relations and amplifying the voices of the Global South.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa ASEAN is an 11-episode travelogue featuring fusion cuisine from ASEAN countries while showcasing local cultures and traditions. Hosted by Chef Fikri and Chef Naim, the programme brings together professional and renowned chefs to explore the region’s diverse culinary heritage.\n\nIn this episode, both chefs travel to Cambodia to discover its local cuisine and cultural traditions.

programme.title: ASEAN - Jejak Halal ASEAN
programme.desc: Jejak Halal ASEAN is a travelogue exploring the diverse cultures and lifestyles of Muslim communities across ASEAN countries. In this episode, the programme travels to Songkhla, Thailand, to discover the local Muslim community and its way of life.

programme.title: ASEAN -Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: This episode of ASEAN Women Entrepreneurship highlights the determination of women entrepreneurs from Cambodia and Brunei in developing their businesses and contributing to economic growth. It also explores the challenges they face, the importance of support systems, and business strategies in empowering women to succeed in entrepreneurship.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN

programme.desc: Travelogue exploring the history and development of Islam in Uzbekistan, tracing its rich Islamic heritage, historic sites and enduring influence on the country’s culture and society.

Kak Maggie seorang wanita cina yang buat kerja seperti sloth tetapi tahu tentang semua kedudukan kewangan hotel. Tuan Rudi pula telah melarikan diri kerana dia dikejar oleh Ah Long kerana tidak mampu membayar hutang.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi gets the ultimate football experience at Anfield Stadium, home to the Liverpool Football Club! He explores the champion wall and locker room before hitting the playing field. He learns how to be a mascot and do cool tricks with Mighty Red, then receives lessons from pro players Taylor Hinds and Eartha Cummings, practicing drills for defender and goalkeeper positions, even getting his own jersey!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Do you ever wonder about all the animals on our planet? So does Blippi! Join him as he heads to the world-famous San Diego Zoo to discover something new. In one of the biggest zoos in the world, there is so much to see and learn. From beautiful, colorful macaws to amazing camouflaging bugs, Blippi learns all about the unique animals we share our planet with.

programme.title: Blippi: Specials
programme.desc: How does a recycling truck work? What happens on a farm? Will this object Sink or Float? Blippi explores the world around us with silly dance moves, fun songs, and awesome adventures. There is so much to learn about, it will make you want to shout 'BLIPPI'!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are on the move! When modifications to Fuse's truck cause it to develop a mind of its own and turn truly monstrous, he must take back control to protect his friends. Then, Pogo loses his license after a bout of reckless driving and is horrified to discover that he's got Jeff as his examiner! Plus, when Newt is upstaged by Pogo, she grows determined to become strong herself with some help from Fuse.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Pogo finally meets his match when he annoys an equally annoying and determined bird species called a 'Twitcher.' Then, when a highly infectious fever hits the cul-de-sac, Zee finds himself playing nurse to all his friends, who display a variety of extreme symptoms. Finally, Jeff accidentally causes Pogo to crash-land, causing him to lose his memory, and Jeff decides to rehabilitate him.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into some magical situations! Pogo is bored, so when he discovers a genie in a magic lamp who grants three wishes, he uses them to try and get his friends in the mood for fun. Then, Jeff wants to impress his friends with his hors d'oeuvres, but he is upstaged by Zee, who has a secret ingredient. Finally, Zee accidentally gets on Bubbles' rescue mission to stop a meteor storm and his surprising talent may be just what she needs!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The day takes a disastrous turn when Gramps, and then Zak, are swallowed whole by a giant koi fish! As the rest of the team tries to figure out how to rescue them, their problems get even bigger. They are ambushed by Adilla's roaches, who capture them to be the 'special gift' for Lidia's birthday party. The remaining Insectibles must now escape a bizarre party to save their friends from the belly of a fish.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: When Adilla fires the roach brothers, Hye and Lo, the Insectibles make a surprising decision and recruit them for a mission to retrieve a Shrinkinator part. This strange new alliance is immediately tested when their quest leads them into a mysterious house. Trapped inside with a community of bonkers bugs and their formidable caretaker, Nurse Bapkis, the team must devise a clever plan to escape.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Syd's heart is captured by Norma, a beautiful snail, but her shell holds a shocking secret: it's a vital Shrinkinator part! When Adilla's roaches attack to claim it, Syd must bravely defend his new love. Meanwhile, Chowser makes a solemn vow to protect his beloved caterpillar friends as they prepare to transform into butterflies. programme.desc: It's an adventurous kind of day for Blippi as he remembers his top ten favorite moments at Amusement and Water Parks! Join Blippi as he rides on spinning tea cups, goes on roller coasters, slides down water slides and even learns about under water safety.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for Vehicle Month and discover amazing trucks! Learn about monster trucks with Megan, see why flies love garbage trucks, explore an ice cream truck with Sherry Pop, and see how Kareem the Crane builds a skyscraper.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Explore amazing vehicles this Vehicle Month! Help Blippi and Meekah fix the BlippiMobile. See mail delivery, fly a space rocket, visit a construction site, learn about firetrucks, and race a fast Formula 1 car!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Pogo wants to go skydiving with Newt, but she doesn't want to go. He soon discovers the only thing that can get her to agree: the final sticker for her collection. Then, Pogo gets his hands on Bubbles' mind control chips and picks poor Fuse as the object of his latest experiment! Finally, Pogo convinces the others a monster is on the loose, but it's just another one of his pranks.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Joey and Boo are a pair of losers when their search for food goes wrong. They battle a fly for a pear, get stuck in jelly and ride an out-of-control meatball. They also get trapped inside a worm, get stuck in earwax and deal with a leaky tap. No matter what they do, their simple tasks turn into wild, chaotic adventures.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for magical mayhem and manic missions with Joey and Boo! The chaos begins when they concoct a witch's brew that's too potent and transforms Boo into a giant four-eyed creature! Then, they find a magical phone on the ground and start taking selfies and playing music, but things quickly get out of hand. The magical mayhem continues when a pot of ink changes their color, turning them into fugitives on the run from the bug police!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Syd takes on a new role as the backyard mail carrier, but his haste leads to a series of comical package mix-ups that accidentally l and him three dates on the same night! While Syd juggles his romantic predicament, the rest of the team faces a crisis of their own. They find a key Shrinkinator part, but at the same moment, Willow and Syd's bionics begin to dangerously malfunction, forcing them to choose between the mission and their own safety.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: When Willow starts acting secretive and skipping her duties, the rest of the team gets worried and hires a detective to spy on her. Their investigation leads to a shocking revelation: Willow has been secretly mentoring their friend Chowser through his amazing transformation into a butterfly! The team must quickly adapt to Chowser's new, winged form as they work together on their latest mission to save a group of ants.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The discovery of a fresh pizza sparks a massive race across the yard, with every bug competing for a slice. But after the race, the Insectibles are accused of cheating! They soon discover the 'Defraudibles,' a team of lookalikes, are ruining their good name. To clear their reputation, the real Insectibles must challenge their doppelgangers to a series of carnival-style games to finally prove who the true heroes of the yard are.

programme.title: People and Profit
programme.desc: The business show that goes beyond the numbers and the corporate jargon! Stephen Carroll breaks down major business stories and looks at how they affect our lives.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: A third-rate British spy is sent to an island, unaware he is there to lure Soviet spies.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: High Voltage [Extended Version]
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Southern Barbeque Night
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a Southern-style feast for the whole family including Crunchy Coleslaw and Oven Barbeque Chicken all in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: Greek Night
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: Spring Inspiration
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: Pan-seared Scallops with Peanut Sauce Noodles and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including pan-seared scallops with peanut sauce noodles and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Pine Nut Pesto Scallops with Apple Celery Slaw and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Pine Nut Pesto Scallops with Apple Celery Slaw and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Start Here
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Start Here by Sohla El-Waylly! Follow along as Shahir makes a punch-you-in-the-face sauce, beautiful seared scallops, an indulgent chocolate pudding pie for grown-ups, and much more!

programme.title: Trentino-Alto Adige
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Campania
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Emilia Romagna
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Calabria
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Lombardy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Umbria
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Sardegna
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Friuli Venezia Guilia
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Trentino-Alto Adige
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Molise
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Valle D'Aosta
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Tuscany
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: Veneto
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: Puglia
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Lazio
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah discover that they can really control their parents. They call their best friends over to plan an unforgettable weekend together. They finally get to do the things that their parents never allowed. Now, they can go all out and have the best time of their life.

programme.title: Take CTRL

The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Take CTRL

programme.title: Take CTRL

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: For one assignment, the students partner up, interview and write an essay about each other. Danial is partnered up, by random draw from a hat, with Amelia. They sit down and interview each other. Danial enjoys talking about himself while Amelia is a hard person to go through. When the essays are done, Amelia — being the best in the class in English — insists on checking Danial’s essay, because each pair shares a mark. Danial is reluctant at first because he’s insecure about his writing but finally gives up. She reads his essay and discovers that he’s written a flattering essay about her. She finally opens, telling him more about herself.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond asks the students to talk about their heroes. But they misunderstood and talk about their favourite superheroes instead. James Blond corrects them and tells them about the real meaning of a ‘hero’ and not fictitious heroes, for example his uncle Edward who’s an SAS army and a mountaineer. Sam, the quiet one in the class, is too shy to even speak a complete sentence. However, he seems to be confident when correcting people about these superheroes’ facts. He’s a real pedantic geek. James Blond decides to talk about a superhero in class, getting all the facts wrong, to get Sam to speak confidently. And Sam, can’t bear hearing all the wrong facts, finally gains confidence and speak up.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Mawar and Florence decide to start a business, selling clothes online. Florence becomes the model of all Mawar’s designs. This business becomes successful and popular in such a short and demands are overwhelming. It takes a toll on Mawar’s studies. Florence convinces her that she needs to focus on school. Mawar argues that she doesn’t need to study because her business is doing so well. Florence quits the business. Mawar can’t do the business alone and has a hard time designing because Florence is her muse and it’s more fun with Florence. They decide to close the business and focus on school.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: PE class. The PE teacher injures himself while warming up the class. Zack has to take over. The boys want to play football, and the girls want to play volleyball. Zack tries to get them to do other activities such as high jump, 100-meter dash, etc. Danial challenges Zack on a high jump, shot put, and 100-meter dash. If Danial wins 2 out of 3, they get to play football next week. Zack agrees to do the challenge. Danial wins the high jump. Zack wins the shot-put challenge. Lastly, the 100-meter dash. Zack wins by a close distance. But he promises the students that they get to play football and volleyball anyway because as long as they exercise, it’s okay. But the girls play football, and the boys have to play volleyball.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up

The acting’s horrendous, the pronunciation of words is wrong, and they lack confidence. But Cikgu Lakshmi is patient. James Blond, who checks out the class out of curiousity, watches their show and stands in for one of the students, just to test out his acting skills. He puts on a show and overacts in his scenes, way too dramatic, a stark contrast of the students. His performance is distracting. Cikgu Lakshmi decides to make it a student-only affair. James Blond is disappointed because he can’t express himself onstage anymore. One day, when school ends, he goes up on the empty stage and begins monologuing without realizing that Cikgu Lakshmi is watching him.

After an argument at the dinner table, Sky and Ramunah coop up in their rooms to rant about their parents with their friends. Right there and then, they discover a video game that can take their problems away.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah discover that they can really control their parents. They call their best friends over to plan an unforgettable weekend together. They finally get to do the things that their parents never allowed. Now, they can go all out and have the best time of their life.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah received a message from a mysterious person whose name is beta about how they can save their parents. Before taking on the mission, the kids trains for it and they reflect on how they have been treating their parents, as well as questioning if their newfound freedom is more important than saving their parents.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky, Ramunah and their friends takes on the mission to save their parents after training hard for it.. Everything goes almost swimmingly, if not because of the three stooges, and along the way, Sky and Ramunah discover that their parents have been caring about them all along, but unfortunately, the kids failed the last task and they lost their parents to the limbo.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: For one assignment, the students partner up, interview and write an essay about each other. Danial is partnered up, by random draw from a hat, with Amelia. They sit down and interview each other. Danial enjoys talking about himself while Amelia is a hard person to go through. When the essays are done, Amelia — being the best in the class in English — insists on checking Danial’s essay, because each pair shares a mark. Danial is reluctant at first because he’s insecure about his writing but finally gives up. She reads his essay and discovers that he’s written a flattering essay about her. She finally opens, telling him more about herself.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond asks the students to talk about their heroes. But they misunderstood and talk about their favourite superheroes instead. James Blond corrects them and tells them about the real meaning of a ‘hero’ and not fictitious heroes, for example his uncle Edward who’s an SAS army and a mountaineer. Sam, the quiet one in the class, is too shy to even speak a complete sentence. However, he seems to be confident when correcting people about these superheroes’ facts. He’s a real pedantic geek. James Blond decides to talk about a superhero in class, getting all the facts wrong, to get Sam to speak confidently. And Sam, can’t bear hearing all the wrong facts, finally gains confidence and speak up.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Mawar and Florence decide to start a business, selling clothes online. Florence becomes the model of all Mawar’s designs. This business becomes successful and popular in such a short and demands are overwhelming. It takes a toll on Mawar’s studies. Florence convinces her that she needs to focus on school. Mawar argues that she doesn’t need to study because her business is doing so well. Florence quits the business. Mawar can’t do the business alone and has a hard time designing because Florence is her muse and it’s more fun with Florence. They decide to close the business and focus on school.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: PE class. The PE teacher injures himself while warming up the class. Zack has to take over. The boys want to play football, and the girls want to play volleyball. Zack tries to get them to do other activities such as high jump, 100-meter dash, etc. Danial challenges Zack on a high jump, shot put, and 100-meter dash. If Danial wins 2 out of 3, they get to play football next week. Zack agrees to do the challenge. Danial wins the high jump. Zack wins the shot-put challenge. Lastly, the 100-meter dash. Zack wins by a close distance. But he promises the students that they get to play football and volleyball anyway because as long as they exercise, it’s okay. But the girls play football, and the boys have to play volleyball.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Drama class. Cikgu Lakshmi teaches the students acting and the art of theatre. They put on a very bad show. The acting’s horrendous, the pronunciation of words is wrong, and they lack confidence. But Cikgu Lakshmi is patient. James Blond, who checks out the class out of curiousity, watches their show and stands in for one of the students, just to test out his acting skills. He puts on a show and overacts in his scenes, way too dramatic, a stark contrast of the students. His performance is distracting. Cikgu Lakshmi decides to make it a student-only affair. James Blond is disappointed because he can’t express himself onstage anymore. One day, when school ends, he goes up on the empty stage and begins monologuing without realizing that Cikgu Lakshmi is watching him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students pull a prank on Wan Yunus, the gullible new student from Kelantan. They tell him that his crush, Florence, likes him but she is too shy to tell him. They lie to him about what Florence likes and gets him to dress silly, do silly things, and say silly things to her. He ends up embarrassing himself. The pranksters call it quits and apologize to them when they realize they’ve taken it too far. Wan Yunus forgives them. In the end, Florence tells him that she thinks Wan Yunus is cool and they can be friends. It makes Wan Yunus happy.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond decides to learn more about the locals. The students are happy to help. They teach him all the basics like ordering food at a mamak restaurant, the salutations such as "macha", "brader" (not ‘brother’), "boss", etc. Wan Yunus teaches him how to flirt in Kelantanese dialect. In the end, he uses his knowledge to impress Cikgu Joji and takes her out on a date.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Malaysia Day. Class decoration competition lead by Gowri. They excel in the competition, winning first place. However, before they can receive the grand prize the judge, principal Puan Aida, asks them what exactly is Malaysia Day. None of the students can answer (even James Blond). The whole class is punished. Cikgu Joji educates them on Malaysia Day while all of them stand on their chairs.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Sports Day. Zack, being the representative teacher for Rumah Sultan, trains the students for the main and most popular event which is the tug-of-war. He takes it way too seriously and his training is gruelling. On Sports Day, the team coached by James Blond (Rumah Lannister) wins and Zack’s team defeated. Zack demands a match between the coaches and challenges James Blond for a one-on-one tug-of-war. Puan Aida stops the match and makes the two teachers realize of how foolish and childish their rivalry is. Sports Day is about the students and for the students. They apologize to each other. But when Puan Aida goes away, the students ask them to continue the match as they cheer on.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Ronaldo has the flu but still attends school. He tries his best to hide it but James Blond finds out and tells him that he needs to go to the doctor and rest at home. But Ronaldo insists that he’s okay and the lessons should go on. But he keeps interfering the lesson by sneezing, coughing, and making everyone uncomfortable. In the end, James Blond takes Ronaldo to the teachers’ office and asks Encik Yusof to take care of the class. Ronaldo finally admits he’s sick and takes advantage of James Blond’s hospitality by being a demanding patient. A few days later, the whole class is down with flu. Ronaldo is the only one who’s well.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Vitagen holds an audition session at SMK Ayer Dalam. Fiona is excited because she is very interested in Vitagen drink. Encik Yusof also wants to grab the golden opportunity to appear on the TV screen.

programme.title: No Gadget No Problem
programme.desc: Dunia di mana keseronokan dan kreativiti tidak terikat pada skrin. Mengajak kanak-kanak untuk meneroka, bermain, dan menemui kegembiraan dalam aktiviti tanpa penggunaan peranti elektronik.
